ops.text: 2026-07-27 — CORRECTION: the "daemonkit release freeze" is retired. It was the stabilization plan's own anti-churn device (a reaction to the swarm's ~15 releases in 2 days), never a user mandate — the user has explicitly disclaimed it. Normal release cadence applies to daemonkit effective immediately: ship when there's a coherent changeset, one release per changeset (the batching lesson in doc f2ec2cb4 stands as guidance, not a gate). No release is currently queued; v0.20.9 remains the fleet baseline because it's the newest, not because it's frozen.
